name: Roast Beef (Deli)
siboNotes: Plain roast beef is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Watch for added seasonings or marinades that may contain garlic or onion powder.
preparationTips: Choose plain roast beef without added seasonings when possible
Check ingredient labels for garlic powder, onion powder, or high FODMAP additives
Opt for freshly sliced deli meat over pre-packaged varieties when available
Store properly refrigerated and consume within 3-5 days of purchase
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (20-25g per serving)
Good source of B-vitamins, especially B12
